description: Native send, with optional media URLs or inline media.

body.description: The message text. Its length and characters decide the segments and the encoding (GSM-7 or UCS-2).

from.description: The sender: an E.164 number or an alphanumeric sender ID.

media.description: Files sent inline as MMS media, base64 encoded.

media_urls.description: Public links SendMock downloads, like Twilio's `MediaUrl`.

metadata.description: Any JSON you want stored with the message and echoed in its events.

status_callback.description: Your app's URL that receives each status change (queued, sent, delivered, failed).

to.description: The recipient, an E.164 number; `whatsapp:+...` sends over WhatsApp.

name: sendmock_sms_send
